standfirst: Encephalomyocarditis virus, Theiler's murine encephalomyelitis virus and Saffold virus in one module: thirteen polyprotein products, 60 profiles, every feature built at the documented defaults. The two out-of-frame proteins of the genus, L* and 2B*, are not declared here; the coverage audit measures what that costs.

modules.Cardiovirus: The leader is a 67-76 residue zinc-finger host antagonist, not a protease, which is why this genus is separate from Aphthovirus whose leader occupies the same slot at 201 residues. Only POLY carries copy_num.

gaps: No declared feature lacks a collection. The thinnest are VPg at 22 sequences and 3A at 36, both of which still cleared the -m 5 floor. What is missing is not a thin feature but two undeclared proteins: L* and 2B*, both out of frame with the polyprotein.
derived: All thirteen mature peptides are cleavage products of POLY, with both extensions set to 0.
